oracle.invariant: S1: 'SC-3: the files a Tracy setup run wrote ride on its row, never a "source unknown" row' is ok — the V2 page is exactly [writes:setup:<run>], that row has effects.files {count: 25, sha: <moment>} and two content resources, counts.unknown 0 (pre-fix: a second row git:<moment sha>). S1: 'SC-3: a setup moment the run did not hear back from is still its own, never Unknown' is ok — the commit known only by its trailer Tracy-Turn: setup-<run>:1 rides on the run's row (count 9); a trailer naming a run the site never had stays a git row. S2: 'a setup run holds the webroot: opened before its first write, its moment taken after the brand, once' is ok (order open → apply → brand → close); 'a failed apply still takes the moment…' is ok (open → apply → close, state failed); 'a webroot that cannot be held is no reason to fail the site' is ok (state applied). S2: 'setupWebroot: the run seals under its own turn, then commits its moment and records the carrier write' is ok — the host is asked {kind: webroot-seal-outside, turn: setup-<run>:1} then {kind: webroot-moment, title: 'Tracy setup', turn: setup-<run>:1}; site_write holds one row {action: setup.files, via: setup-moment, origin: setup, origin_ref: <run>, target: {sha, files: 25}}; 'setupWebroot: an EmDash site keeps no webroot history…' is ok (no host call). S3: 'SC-3 setup run: its turn id holds the webroot like a chat turn, and its moment names the run' is ok — what was dirty before the run is one outside seal, a look while the run writes seals nothing, the moment's body ends 'Tracy-Turn: setup-<run>:1'. S4: both tests pass: six idle drops of an opened socket give 7 sockets and no console.error (pre-fix: 3 sockets and the error); three connections that never open stop the loop with one report. S5: the five path-security-probe tests pass: a missing file in site B, a missing file under a missing directory of site B (read and write guard) and a missing file behind a symlink planted in site A into site B all give the same {code: forbidden, status: 403, message: 'path "<path>" is outside workspace'} as an existing one (pre-fix: 400 fs-error ENOENT); inside site A a missing file still gives 400 ENOENT, and with the fence off nothing changes. seat-isolation-files-tab.test.ts: all 7 tests ok, including 'plugin: the fence is no existence oracle…' (read, write and remove guards). S6: chat-route.test.mjs all ok, including 'Create with records the pick only while the chat route is on…': recordsPickOnCreate follows the switch and the dialog's only bare `void choose(inspiration.id)` is behind it (pre-fix: the Create with handler called choose unconditionally and the host answered 403 CHAT_DESIGN_SYSTEM_OFF on every press).
